label: geographical part of
definition: The first named neighborhood, district or area is geographically contained in the second place.
scope_notes: Area/section/neighborhood-of/in strongly dominates. This is a place-to-containing-place relationship, distinct from personal residence, travel, schools or an organization located somewhere. The listed longer paths may be noisy without invalidating clean containment evidence; incompatible neighborhood names require identity review.
